QUOTE: `app/actions/websocket/channel.ts:463` | Nothing extra | If the user is viewing this channel, kick them out with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`; then remove the current user from the channel locally.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table says that when archived channels are not viewable and the user is viewing the channel, they are kicked out and removed from it locally. The `archiveChannel` row says that when channels are viewable, `delete_at` is set locally so the channel stays visible as archived, which matches "kept and marked deleted".
